fields.name: IShardKey
fields.contract: IShardKey is the library contract for a shard-key value. An implementation exposes a signed 16-bit ShardId, an IsEmpty indicator, a string external representation through ToExternalString(), a binary representation through ToArray(), and a UTF-8 byte representation through ToUtf8().
